Brent crude is 45% above its one-year median and aluminium 21% above July baseline, with EU natural gas 56% elevated. Supplier equity moves (Smoore -14.9%, EVE Energy -6.3%, Infineon down 8.1% cumulatively) were unconfirmed across three days but have reversed; ITC's geopolitical flag also downgraded.
